Definition: from G888; to render useless, i.e. spoil:--become unprofitable.
BiblicalUsage: To become unprofitable, to be spoiled, made useless — achreioo appears once, in Paul's verdict on all humanity: "They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one." The word is the hinge of Romans 3: every mouth stopped, the whole world guilty before God.
TheologicalSignificance: One verb for becoming useless is a small word, and the thunder in the verse comes from Paul's verdict on all humanity, not from the verb itself.
